author: Zoqs
body:
IGN: JustMatrix
Reason ban: Excessive Infractions
Banned by: Tazz
Why I would like to be unbanned:


Ok, so it begins

I'm not a monster going to eat the server or crash it or do shit like that, You guys can keep an eye on me for as long as you like, everyone trusts me, everyone will trust me, just after a few days you'll be like "Ohh Matrix changed , hes like a normal good pvper and showing respect to everyone else on here." but you guys don't understand this, I may have been a bad player , I may have disrespect  but yeah, People always make mistakes in their lives, atleast everyone has made a mistake (All the 7-8 billion people living in the world at this moment) This is like getting confession in the church, telling the priest all the things you have done wrong. I
I can't just make this a story so lets get on with the main topic, as you know, I disrespected a lot of good pvpers on avicus. To this day forth, I will never ever EVER EVER disrespect and spam  again on avicus, You can keep an eye at me on all times.

I have spent around 30-40 minutes making this appeal for you and making sure everythings correct. I'm sure this one shouldn't be denied, even though most truthfull ban appeals are, But I swear down my life it wont happen again :) Please don't deny this, I will be very sad if you do deny this efforty appeal :( i I would never use disrespect and spam again in my life, From now on I'm going to report every hacker I meet in avicus  because of my stupidity of doing that mistake I feel so lonely now. It would be alot of time consuming to keep recording hackers but its totally worth it from now. I would never hackusate  again on avicus, I almost died of shock when the message came up and said that I was banned on avicus So now I feel so lonely, I miss my friends and haters on avicus because of my idiotic behaviour.

I swear down my whole life that I won't disrepect  again, If you really think I am still hackusating in the future, ban me again . I would never hackusate ever again, I really want to be unbanned so I can mess around with my friends again, like pvping together and stuff I really want to be unbanned on the avicus What I'm thinking is that whats stupid was my behaviour.

I get banned for my behaviour To be honest with myself, I felt like punching myself in the forehead when I saw that ban message. I am very very sorry, You must believe me, and also trust me, I swear to fucking god I would never spam and hackusate on avicus Ever in my whole life. You can keep an good eye on me even though I won't do anything bad, I know that I was very bold by spamming and hackusating and very angry with myself, but yeah, people make mistakes, it always happens, I totally agree with how bad my mistake was, I'll give you a rating out of ten, I'd say 1 being the worst possible behaviour ever on avicus and 10 Such Minor mistake and kind of mannered way, I'm probably a 6, Opinions are opinions though, they aren't facts, I would love to be unbanned on avicus because I felt very lonely being banned and not being able to play on a server . This is one of the biggest appeals I have ever made on avicus, and it was made especially for you so you can think about it and maybe let me have another chance. I swear SO MUCH I won't do this stupid shit again.

But yeah, Please think about this, I love avicus, It is a perfect server for me to play on and enjoy myself having fun with the other fellow players playing on this server aswell. I always bring my friends here to do destroy the monument to have  fun with them. I would love to be unbanned on avicus for one other reason, I'm missing my friends there and I think its a great place to train and practice pvping, I am a decent pvper, but yeah, Hackusate is for noobs.
I really need another chance, I really do to be honest with you, I deserve another chance with an unban, Well I kind of deserve it because I am being honest here, What I done was very wrong of me and I almost died of shock when I saw the ban message, I know what I am doing from now on in the future, I have a brain, I will use my brain this time, instead of being a no brain kid spamming in chat HACKS, Using a brain is the key to life. You wouldn't get a job if you couldn't use your brain properly, you wouldn't be able to really do anything to be honest without using your brain the right way, but what I just did that time was heart breaking, and not only for you, but for me aswell.

Another chance to being unbanned on the avicus , that would be great. I would be very satisfied if you could do this for me. Please I fen, You should trust me and if you want you can keep an eye on me, I was banned on another server before, I learned from that mistake, I learned my lesson and I stayed as a player on the server for 1 year without getting banned again on it, (I did quit it though and came across this server, avicus. I had so much fun here I decided to spend a huge amount of time training and practicing pvp against other fellow players

Besure to read all of this, atleast think about it. I understand what I have done wrong and it won't happen again, you can always watch me while I'm playing if you want, its up to you

Well, End of my appeal, But always remember this staff members, "If you catch me doing something again on the avicus that makes you heartbroken, and other players too, Besure to Ban me forever without no chance of appealing." I will learn from this mistake, From now on, I will record all the hackers, post on youtube, and report directly here to keep this community nice and safe without anymore bullshit hackers,spammers or advertisers, I am not fooling around, I'm serious, I learn from every mistakes, bad or good.

Im sorry for all the shit i told you guys. From now on i wound't be like that anymore and ill love every single of you. Avicus got  beeing my home and family and i place were i could talk to other players. I love to talk with players on ts and team with them on scrims. I know my behaviour was bad but i couldn't see it. I hope you guys can see that i really have changed and that everybody can forgive me. I know a lot of players hates me for the shit i did but i saw the light

Please do not create hate comments down bellow

Thank you for reading this, now please don't deny this, read the above paragraph.
Kind regards,
-Matrix

title: Matrix's Ban Appeal( Long WARNING)

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body: You are only banned for a month, now less than 3 weeks. Your ban is valid, and although your apology is nice, you can't be unbanned because your ban is valid and it's only temporary. It's not that long of a ban, and you can use that time to properly change.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
As Tazz said, Thank you for admitting you did break the rules. However, we do not remove valid punishments even if the player says sorry. I am sorry but the punishment will stay in place. This punishment is valid and the appeal is denied.

Regards,
Edans
